_notice: HYPOTHETICAL ASSUMPTIONS for an educational finance project (Introduction to Finance, AITU). Not market data, not a forecast, not an investment offer. Every number is a student assumption unless a source is given.
units: All money values in KZT; prices exclude VAT (VAT is treated as a pass-through and ignored).

subscriptionPerYear.basis: Assumption: B2B annual subscription (300,000 KZT/month) for an organization running unlimited voting sessions.

perElectionFee.basis: Assumption: pay-per-session price for organizations without a subscription.

subscribersEndOfYear.basis: Assumption: net subscribers at year end after churn (hypothetical joint-stock companies, boards, HOAs, NGOs).

annualChurnRate.basis: Assumption: 10% of opening subscribers leave each year; replaced by extra gross additions.

perElectionSessions.basis: Assumption: pay-per-session voting sessions sold per year.

customers.revenueTiming: Subscription revenue uses the AVERAGE of opening and closing subscribers (customers join evenly during the year).

cacPerNewSubscriber.basis: Assumption: sales + marketing cost to win one new subscriber (CAC).

perElectionSalesCommission.basis: Assumption: 5% of pay-per-session revenue paid as sales commission.

initialInvestment._definition: Year-0 cash outflows before the first sale. Counted ONCE in the cash-flow statement; not repeated in operating expenses.

productDevelopment.basis: Assumption: hardening this prototype into a production product (≈3 engineers × 6 months). Capitalised and amortised over 3 years in the income statement.

externalSmartContractAudit.basis: Assumption: one professional external smart-contract and application security audit before launch (expensed in Year 0).

legalAndRegulatoryReview.basis: Assumption: Kazakhstan legal review (corporate voting rules, personal data, contracts) before launch (expensed in Year 0).

companySetupAndEquipment.basis: Assumption: LLP registration, laptops, initial tooling (expensed in Year 0).

teamFte.basis: Assumption: average full-time employees per year.

costPerFtePerMonth.basis: Assumption: fully loaded monthly cost per employee incl. payroll taxes and contributions.

infrastructureBasePerYear.basis: Assumption: cloud hosting, managed blockchain nodes, monitoring, backups (fixed part).

infrastructurePerSubscriber.basis: Assumption: variable hosting cost per average subscriber per year.

infrastructurePerSession.basis: Assumption: variable cost per pay-per-session election (support, notifications, transaction costs).

legalCompliancePerYear.basis: Assumption: ongoing legal, data-protection and compliance advice.

recurringSecurityAudit.basis: Assumption: re-audit after major releases in Years 2 and 3 (Year 1 is covered by the Year-0 audit).

generalAndAdministrativePerYear.basis: Assumption: office, accounting, software licences, insurance.

amortisationYears.basis: Assumption: straight-line amortisation of capitalised product development.

corporateIncomeTaxRate.basis: General CIT rate of 20% under the Tax Code of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 214-VIII of 18 July 2025 (in force from 1 January 2026), as summarised by the State Revenue Committee and professional advisers. Verify with the official text: https://adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/K2500000214

lossCarryForward.basis: Simplification: tax losses are carried forward and offset against later profits within the 3-year horizon. Verify current carry-forward rules with a tax adviser.

accounting.workingCapital: Simplification: no changes in working capital (subscriptions billed and collected within the year).

discountRate.basis: Assumption: 25% required return reflecting early-stage venture risk (course range 20–30%). Not derived from market data.

terminalGrowthRate.basis: Assumption used ONLY in the supplementary 'with terminal value' metric.

safetyBufferRate.basis: Assumption: 20% buffer on top of the projected cash need.

regulatoryDelay.label: Pessimistic 3 — 6-month regulatory delay (Year-1 revenue −50%, +5m KZT legal)
